customers.evidence: Our mission is to deliver great value to our customers every day.

employees.evidence: With stores and offices around the world, there is a breadth of opportunities at TJX to discover a career in retail.

community.evidence: Corporate Responsibility is an important part of how we conduct our business.

shareholders.evidence: our strong financial results and cash generation have allowed us to simultaneously invest in the growth of the business and return cash to shareholders.

result.analyst_notes: Factual and customer-led, with the mission statement placed first and framed around value and price (20% to 60% below full-price retailers). Shareholder returns appear as a secondary, descriptive point. Third-person corporate voice mostly, with some first-person plural (we, our). Commitments are stated absolutely. Corporate responsibility is referenced only through a generic link with no specifics.
